decisions.statement: The document is read by the agent settings module rather than here.
The agent settings module is imported from beside this module and its function called.
A settings document that will not read leaves the spawn carrying the per-spawn overrides.
A page or a file the agent settings reach for and miss refuses the spawn.
A document fault is told from a page fault by a mark rather than by a message.
The settings are read once for a spawn rather than asked for until they answer.

definition: the settings one agent spawn is composed from and written out with
